dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Progressive and symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins appear smooth and continuous with no localized bulges or indentations visible at the water-skin interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median pixel intensity corresponds to a light slate-grey skin tone.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse grayscale gradient across the dorsal surface with no sharp transition boundaries between pigmented zones.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of a single, dark longitudinal linear mark on the right dorsal quadrant and multiple high-contrast white circular spots across the dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible longitudinal linear scratch or rake mark located on the upper right dorsal surface.
